task.title: To create a Search and Select Action

step.cmd: In the main ribbon under Actions, click the arrow and select Search and Select.
In the Action Name field, type Select Account.
From the Objects list, choose Account.
In the Search window, click the check box next to Name.
In the Name in Fields to Display in Search Results, click the check box next to it and the Sort check box to the right.
From the Results area, choose Single.
